quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics results briefing Q&A: Financial Results Briefing Q&A, May 2026 (05-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the company is focusing investment on Vietnam due to increasing production demand in Southeast Asia; it entered Vietnam about 15 years ago and has continued to invest there. Asked about Vietnam's sales ratio going forward: currently around 60%, and the company expects it to increase further.

quarterly_data.quarter: Meiko Electronics results briefing Q&A: Financial Results Briefing Q&A, May 2026 (05-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): its large production capacity for HDI PCBs has helped it capture new demand in AI servers (its competitive advantage there); the boards used for AI servers and satellite communications are high multilayer HDI PCBs. The mid-term management plan is based on customer forecasts and other factors, and the current rise in raw material prices has been incorporated into this year's forecast.
